page.overview:
Who is Meriwether?

Dr. Meriwether is an NPC featured in the video game Darius Bowman plays. He accompanies the player on their mission to escape Isla Nublar alive. He appears to serve as some kind of guide for the player. During Darius' first playthrough, Meriwether is killed by a pack of Velociraptors after crossing the river. He is not featured in the boy's second playthrough where he ultimately wins.
